relations.description: SIB12 contains information elements that are assembled from received segments.
When SIB12 value tag changes, UE discards all stored segments.
When all segments are received, UE assembles SIB12 information elements.
SIB12 information elements contain sl-ConfigCommonNR configuration.
sl-ConfigCommonNR contains sl-FreqInfoList for sidelink frequencies.
SIB12 information elements contain sl-RadioBearerConfigList for sidelink bearer configuration.
SIB12 information elements contain sl-RLC-BearerConfigList for sidelink RLC bearer configuration.
SIB12 information elements contain sl-MeasConfigCommon for sidelink measurements.
SIB12 information elements contain sl-DRX-ConfigCommon-GC-BC for sidelink DRX configuration.
UE stores received SIB12 segments as part of SIB12 reception procedure.
